why: Splits the session across two namespaces: the six stores land on the base keys while `AppSettings.storage` -- what save.ts and the `__tanks` dev console get -- stays namespaced. Every storage.ts adapter test still passes, because the adapter is untouched; only the wiring is wrong. Killed by `gives the stores and storage the SAME namespaced object`, where a store write becomes unreadable through AppSettings.storage.
killedBy: createBrowserAppSettings gives the stores and `storage` the SAME namespaced object
